source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Mini DP can work with resolution change
1.Power on SUT and boot into OS.
2.Change the current video resolution and color depth to better.
3.Choose the "Test" button to test the changes, then choose "Apply" to accept the changes.
4.Shutdown and restart the OS, then login.
5.Review Event Viewer logs to confirm there are no errors or fault conditions reported.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1.All selectable changes up to 2560 x 1440 at a 16bit color depth should function properly. Higher resolutions may not work properly because of limitations of the video driver used and the supported resolutions of the monitor used.
2.Screen can display w/o error.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Resolution change up - 2560 x 1440x16bit: change the Mini-DP video resolution/color depth up to 2560x1440@16bit in the OS display settings. Requires a person at the display + OS desktop GUI (Test -> Apply); agent can read the current mode with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "xrandr 2>&1 | grep -iE 'connected|\*' | head 2>&1" if a GUI session is present, but the GUI change + visual confirmation are operator/visual.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the xrandr/DRM mode list so the user confirms 2560x1440@16bit applied properly on the Mini-DP display; the GUI apply + visual check are operator.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: resolution change is a GUI/visual check on the Mini-DP display - operator performs it; agent only reads the OS mode.

original_test_intent: Verify every approved selectable MiniDP mode through 2560x1440 at the source-defined 16-bit colour depth, with a visible error-free image, successful restart/login and no display/driver faults in Event Viewer or supporting logs.
original_method: An engineer uses OS GUI Test/Apply for the approved QHD-and-lower matrix, visually checks the MiniDP screen, shuts down/restarts and logs in, then reviews Event Viewer and system/BMC logs.
manual_activity: GUI Test/Apply and the physical judgment that every required QHD-and-lower mode displays without artifacts are core acceptance tasks. Restart/login recovery also requires an engineer.
required_inputs: OS edition/build and display GUI workflow
GPU/driver, MiniDP connector/cable and monitor/EDID identities
Exact 16-bit colour interpretation and all approved selectable modes through 2560x1440
Maintenance approval, display operator, previous mode and alternate console
safety_requirements: Do not force an unadvertised mode/depth or assume the MiniDP output.
Keep alternate console access and a known-good revert mode before GUI application.
Treat restart as service-impacting and preserve logs.
Stop on blank/corrupt image, driver failure, login failure or loss of recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect OS-native GPU, EDID, mode/depth and event data around each approved change.
Track the exact QHD-and-lower matrix and restart timeline.
Compare readback/logs while leaving visual quality and PASS/FAIL to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the mode/depth matrix and recovery plan.
Perform Test/Apply, visually inspect each mode and execute the approved restart/login.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient and platform-mismatched as a default: xrandr is Linux-specific while the source calls for Event Viewer; it neither applies the GUI change nor proves depth, visual quality or restart persistence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented OS-native read-only mode/EDID and event collection after platform identification; do not introduce an automated setting command without a tested recovery path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All selectable modes through 2560x1440, 16-bit colour, Test/Apply, restart/login, Event Viewer and 10/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: PLATFORM METHOD PENDING; RETAIN HUMAN VISUAL CORE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build the exact matrix from EDID and project rules, record electronic mode/depth after each GUI application, photograph a diagnostic pattern, restart once at the approved final mode and export relevant display/driver events.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact OS, GPU/driver, MiniDP cable and monitor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS build, GPU driver/firmware and monitor EDID.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner display specification plus OS/GPU/monitor supported-mode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity and per-mode evidence without replacing the GUI or physical observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No approved lower mode is omitted; no unsupported depth is inferred.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: QHD mode matrix and colour-depth semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mode readback cannot show visible artifacts, scaling errors or colour correctness.

project_override_considerations: The project defines 'all selectable' and 16-bit semantics for its display stack. A reduced matrix is reported only as that approved plan. Missing values affect readiness rather than permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Per-mode GUI, electronic and visual evidence through 2560x1440
Successful restart/login with the approved final mode
Event Viewer/system/BMC/SEL review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The QHD mode, visual, restart and log requirements are internally consistent. Platform-specific 16-bit availability is a readiness clarification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear. Missing platform and mode details do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject PARTIAL and xrandr-only coverage; retain optional readback after OS confirmation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its QHD capability and recovery analysis while applying MANUAL ONLY to the visual/GUI core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves all-selectable coverage and separates tool evidence, visual observation and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents one mode query from standing in for the QHD matrix, 16-bit depth, screen quality, restart persistence and Event Viewer checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: Even if mode enumeration and logs are automated, the source requires an engineer to manipulate the GUI and observe the physical display for every required mode. The core is therefore MANUAL ONLY.
